sources.title: North Mini Code model documentation
sources.evidence: Maps north-mini-code-1-0 to North Mini Code, the first North-family model; states 30B total / 3B active MoE, Apache 2.0, 256K context and 64K maximum output, trained for agentic coding.

sources.title: Announcing Cohere’s North Mini Code — June 9, 2026
sources.evidence: Dated release announcement identifies the exact API identifier and says open weights are available on Hugging Face; explicitly reports 30B total, 3B active and Apache 2.0.

sources.title: North-Mini-Code-1.0 model card
sources.evidence: Identifies developer, text-only input/text output, sparse decoder Transformer, interleaved thinking and tool use. Gives tool-call/history examples, 256000 context and 64000 output in its OpenCode configuration, alongside a vLLM max-model-len example of 320000.

sources.title: Introducing North Mini Code: Cohere’s First Model For Developers
sources.publisher: Cohere Code Agents Team / Cohere Labs
sources.evidence: June 9 technical launch article describes decoder-only sparse MoE Transformer: one initial dense layer, 128 experts with 8 selected per token, SwiGLU experts, sigmoid routing and sliding-window/global attention in a 3:1 pattern.

sources.title: North-Mini-Code-1.0 pinned checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Cohere2MoeForCausalLM; cohere2_moe; 49 layers, hidden size 2048, 128 experts, 8 experts per token, first_k_dense_replace=1, BF16, sliding window 4096 and max_position_embeddings=500000. No multimodal encoder configuration.

sources.title: North-Mini-Code-1.0 BF16 tensor index and corresponding shard headers
sources.evidence: Index declares total_parameters=30484303872 and total_size=60968607744 across 49 shards. Independently retrieved only headers by HTTP Range for all 49 pinned shards (2293640 header bytes): all 18730 tensors match index keys, all BF16, all learned weight tensors, summed shape products 30484303872. No packed storage, quantization scales or saved non-weight buffers. Only embedding and final norm occur outside decoder layers.

sources.title: Hugging Face metadata for the official Cohere checkpoint
sources.evidence: Current revision d11e61a842617a22dc328552fa5bb86231ee4f37; safetensors reports 30484303872 BF16 elements. Repository creation is June 5, 2026; this metadata does not establish when it became publicly available.

sources.title: North Mini Code current standalone chat template
sources.evidence: Defaults reasoning on unless reasoning_effort is none; serializes reasoning with START_THINKING/END_THINKING and calls/results with START_ACTION/END_ACTION and START_TOOL_RESULT/END_TOOL_RESULT. Supports function JSON schemas and preserves reasoning in assistant history. Current tokenizer_config has no legacy chat_template.

sources.title: Transformers Cohere2MoE implementation
sources.evidence: Defines learned attention, expert, router, norm and embedding weights. Cohere2MoeForCausalLM ties lm_head.weight to model.embed_tokens.weight, explaining the single embedding tensor in this checkpoint; the tensor sum does not double-count its output use.

sources.title: Transformers Cohere2MoE configuration implementation
sources.evidence: Cohere2MoeConfig defaults tie_word_embeddings to true, consistent with the checkpoint config and absence of a separate lm_head tensor.

sources.title: Introducing North Mini Code: Cohere’s first model for developers
sources.evidence: June 9, 2026 product launch explicitly links official BF16/FP8 weights and describes the exact North-Mini-Code-1.0 variant as 30B total / 3B active, Apache 2.0, 256K total context and 64K maximum generation.

name.note: Exact API identifier maps to this public display name.

developer.note: Cohere and its Cohere Labs research organization developed the model.

family.note: Official documentation explicitly identifies the North model family.

release_date.note: Explicit official launch date. HF repository creation on June 5 is not proof of initial public availability and does not justify replacing this date.

open_weights.note: Official BF16 checkpoint is publicly downloadable; header requests succeeded for all 49 shards without authentication.

license.note: Exact model release is explicitly licensed under Apache 2.0.

parameters_b.note: Complete checkpoint count: sum of shapes for 18730 learned BF16 tensors across all 49 shards is 30484303872, matching index metadata. No scales, packed storage or saved buffers are counted. Tied input/output embedding counted once. The developer rounds this to nominal 30B.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal 3 billion active parameters; exact active count is not published here. Not inferred from the 8-of-128 expert routing ratio.

architecture.note: Decoder-only sparse MoE Transformer: 49 layers, first dense then 48 sparse, 128 experts/8 selected, SwiGLU, sliding-window RoPE attention interleaved with global attention without positional embeddings.

context_window.note: Advertised 256K context; official card specifies 256000 in its client configuration and 64000 maximum output. The 320000 vLLM example and max_position_embeddings=500000 are configuration limits, not a supported replacement for advertised context.

modalities.note: Exact model card explicitly says text-only input and generated text. Shared template image-token handling does not establish image capability for this text checkpoint.

reasoning.note: Native interleaved thinking is explicitly documented. Current standalone template preserves thinking and begins generation with START_THINKING by default; disabling reasoning emits an empty thinking block.

tool_call.note: Native tool use is documented with exact function schemas and tool-result history. Current standalone template serializes calls and results into dedicated action/result tokens.

description.value: Cohere coding model for practical software engineering and agentic edits
description.note: Supported by explicit agentic software-engineering, repository-change, terminal-task and code-generation purposes; no unsupported benchmark or generality claim.

patch.notes: Complete BF16 checkpoint contains 30,484,303,872 learned parameters (30.484303872B), marketed as 30B. Cohere separately reports a nominal 3B active; this is not calculated from expert fractions. Architecture is a decoder-only sparse MoE Transformer with one initial dense layer and 128 experts, selecting 8 per token. Advertised context is 256,000 tokens with 64,000 maximum output; the 500,000 position configuration and 320,000 vLLM example are not substituted for the documented context. June 9 is the explicit official release date; June 5 repository creation alone does not establish public release.

summary: All 14 fields reviewed. Fill missing Apache-2.0 license, sparse MoE architecture, exact 30.484303872B complete BF16 parameter count and nominal developer-reported 3B active count. Confirm text-only modalities, native interleaved thinking/tool calls, 256000 advertised context and June 9 official launch.
